verdict.rationale: Changelog entries confirm a self-hosted Fern docs container exists and can resolve environment variables per request, so one image can serve multiple deployments (fern-docs-11, fern-docs-31). The SDK generator lives in a public GitHub repo, and a community comment calls Fern open-source (fern-gh-1, fern-comm-2). The self-hosting evidence is limited to brief changelog lines, so the setup path, scope and plan requirements are unclear. Missing for 10: dedicated self-hosting/deployment documentation, clarity on whether self-hosting covers the full docs platform (Ask Fern, MCP, Editor) or needs a paid plan, and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
